title: Editor E0 task 12b, store slice: a node-keyed layout store that selects by node id and saves node documents
detail: Decomposed from PROG-E0 on 2026-10-19. components/entity-blocks/node-layout-store.tsx: NodeLayoutProvider and useNodeLayout hold a NodeLayout, select by selectedNid, fold edits over the freshest layout, coalesce undo, and save the whole node document debounced and serialized, keeping a failed draft without a retry loop. A separate store on purpose (ADR-1835): the live type-keyed store is pinned by tests and serves every Space owner. Honest gap: nothing imports it yet, so no surface changes; the Space canvas, live grid and page builder adopt it in the next slices behind render_path_space_profile.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const s=fs.readFileSync('components/entity-blocks/node-layout-store.tsx','utf8');const bad=[];for(const t of ['selectedNid','NodeLayoutProvider','useNodeLayout','const edit = useCallback'])if(!s.includes(t))bad.push('missing '+t);if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1004: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the node store loses node-id selection or its freshest-layout edit. Behavior is node-layout-store.test.tsx.
